# Hello printmd

A free web tool to **style and print** your Markdown as PDF instantly.

## Features

- Real-time preview
- 5 theme presets
- Custom styling
- PDF export

## Code Block

```javascript
const hello = 'world';
console.log(hello);
```

## Table

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Editor | CodeMirror 6 based |
| Preview | markdown-it rendering |
| Theme | 5 presets available |

## Blockquote

> Print your Markdown beautifully!

---

*Made with printmd.*

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: A Markdown editor lets you write documents using Markdown syntax and see the rendered result in real time. printmd is a free online Markdown editor you can use right in your browser.
faq.a2: Yes, all features of printmd are completely free. No signup required and no usage limits.
faq.a3: Yes, printmd supports PWA so once you visit, you can use it without an internet connection.
faq.a4: You can use it on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
faq.a5: All data is stored in your browser's local storage. Nothing is sent to a server, keeping your data private.
